In Table\ \@ref(tab:SubwayHyp), match the RQs with the appropriate *null hypothesis*.
In this question, $p$ represents the proportion of subs shorter than $12$-inches (or longer than $12$-inches, as appropriate), and\ $\mu$ represents the mean length of a sub.


Then, match the RQs with the appropriate *alternative hypothesis*.


```{r SubwayHyp, echo=FALSE}
Terms <- array( "", dim = c(12, 2))

colnames(Terms) <- c("Research question", 
                     "Hypothesis")

Terms[, 1] <- 
  c("1. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub really 12 inches?",
    "2. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub \\emph{different} for white",
    "~ ~  and wholemeal subs?",
    "3. At Subway, is the proportion of 12-inch subs that are shorter than",
    "~ ~ 12 inches \\emph{different} for white and wholemeal subs?",
    "4. At Subway, is the mean length of a 12-inch sub \\emph{longer} for white",
    "~ ~ and wholemeal subs?",
    rep("", 5))

Terms[, 2] <- 
  c("A. $p_\\textrm{white} - p_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 0$",
    "B. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} - \\mu_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 0$",
    "C. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} = \\mu_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 12$",
    "D. $\\bar{x}_\\textrm{white} - \\bar{x}_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 0$",
    "E. $\\bar{x}_\\textrm{white} = \\bar{x}_\\textrm{wholemeal} = 12$",
    "F. $\\mu = 12$",
    "G. $\\mu_\\textrm{white} - \\mu_\\textrm{wholmeal} \\ne 0$",
    "H. $p_\\textrm{white} = p_\\textrm{wholemeal} < 12$",
    "I. $\\mu \\ne 12$",
    "J. $\\bar{x} \\ne 12$",
    "K. $p_\\textrm{white} - p_\\textrm{wholemeal} \\ne 0$",
    "L. $\\mu_{\\text{white}} - \\mu_{\\text{wholemeal}} > 0$")



if( knitr::is_latex_output() ) {
  kable(Terms,
      format = "latex",
      booktab = TRUE,
      align = c("l", "l"),
      escape = FALSE, # Makes the  $\\mu$ (e.g.) work in latex
      linesep = "\\addlinespace",
      caption = "Match RQs with the null (and then the alternative) hypotheses.") %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE,
                  font_size = 10) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, width = "0.68\\\\textwidth") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "0.3\\\\textwidth")
}
```
